Muhammad Yunus heckled by expatriates at New York airport

Muhammad Yunus, former interim leader of Bangladesh, was heckled by Bangladeshi expatriates at New York's JFK airport. Protesters called him a "terrorist" and accused him of killings and undermining democracy. One video circulating on social media captured a man telling Yunus, "You terrorist, why did you come here?" Bangladesh has warned of legal action following the incident.
